title: Formula for the Angular Momentum
text: Angular momentum is given by $$L=I\omega, $$ where $$I$$ is the moment of inertia of an object about an axis and $$\omega$$ is its angular velocity about that axis.

title: Moment of Inertia of Earth in Its Orbit
text: For orbital motion, we treat the Earth as a point mass at a distance $$r$$ from the Sun, so its moment of inertia is $$I=mr**{2},$$ where $$m=5.97\times10**{24}\,\text{kg}$$ is the mass of the Earth and $$r=1.496\times10**{11}\,\text{m}$$ is the average distance from the Earth to the Sun.

title: Find the Angular Velocity
text: The Earth completes one revolution around the Sun in about one year, which is $$3.156\times10**{7}\,\text{s}.$$ Use the same formula for the angular velocity, $$\omega=\frac{2\pi}{T}$$.
